summary.text: Bob Owen is a Republican member of the Louisiana Senate for District 1, representing Orleans, St. Bernard, St. Tammany, according to the Senate member page.
The page lists 2023 as the year elected.
The page lists Bob Owen with committee assignments including Retirement (Vice Chair).

paragraphs.text: The Senate member page lists Bob Owen's education as Northshore High School; Louisiana State University; B.A. Mass Communications.

The Senate member page lists Bob Owen's committee assignments as Retirement (Vice Chair); Education; Health and Welfare; Judiciary B; Finance (Interim Member); Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Northshore Delegation.
